title_en: You Are Made of 37 Trillion Cells #Shorts
desc_en:
An adult human body has about 37.2 trillion cells, and roughly 70% of them are red blood cells. Counting one per second would take over a million years, longer than our species has existed.

Sources: Bianconi et al., Annals of Human Biology 2013; BioNumbers; Hublin et al., Nature 2017.
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #science
